summary.text: Rissa Williams is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary.
According to Ballotpedia, Williams works as a massage therapist and has one child who was attending district schools at the time of her candidacy.
